answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to staked assets. Like a hardy juniper rooting in harsh soil, the protocol anchors identity to capital, forcing an attacker to acquire a jade treasury of tokens to manipulate consensus. Once the zephyr of network volatility shifts, the economic cost of an attack becomes prohibitive, as the agent must burn capital to maintain multiple identities, rendering malicious expansion cryptographically unsustainable.
